checks.name: test
checks.command: cd remy/api && uv run --package remy-api pytest -q tests/features/plan tests/features/dietary tests/features/calculator/test_domain_nutrition.py tests/features/calculator/test_domain_cost.py

checks.name: lint
checks.command: cd remy/api && uv run --package remy-api ruff check src/api/features/plan/filtering.py src/api/features/plan/models.py src/api/features/plan/repository.py src/api/features/plan/service.py --select F,E9

checks.name: typecheck
checks.command: cd remy/api && uv run --package remy-api mypy src/api/features/plan/filtering.py src/api/features/plan/models.py src/api/features/plan/repository.py --ignore-missing-imports
